description: Registry of favorite agent skills and their installation commands. Add new skills to the 'skills' object.

gsd-core.description: Spec-driven development framework designed to prevent context rot across long agent coding sessions via structured discuss->plan->execute->verify cycles.

npxSkills.notes: Installs GSD skills via the skills.sh CLI into agent configuration directory.

npxSkillInstall.notes: Shorthand installer command where skill package resolver supports gsd-core registry.

customCommands.name: Official GSD Core CLI Installer (Global - Claude Code)
customCommands.description: Recommended official installer configured globally for Claude Code.

customCommands.name: Official GSD Core CLI Installer (Project-local - Claude Code)
customCommands.description: Installs GSD Core only for the current project repository.

customCommands.name: Interactive Universal Installer
customCommands.description: Interactive prompt allowing selection of target agent runtime.

gsd-core.troubleshooting: Always use open-gsd/gsd-core rather than outdated gsd-build forks.

mattpocock.description: Modular collection of professional software engineering habits for AI agents: Socratic review (grill-me), TDD enforcement, PRD generation, architecture diagnosis, and triage.

npxSkills.notes: Installs the full suite or individual skills from mattpocock/skills via the Skills CLI.

npxSkillInstall.notes: Shorthand installer command when using npx skill install format.

customCommands.name: Specific Skill: Socratic Code Review (grill-me)
customCommands.description: Installs only the popular /grill-me architecture review skill.

postInstall: /setup-matt-pocock-skills (Configure repo issue tracker, triage labels, and domain docs)
mattpocock.troubleshooting: Run /setup-matt-pocock-skills in the repository root after installation to align with your project conventions.

context-mode.description: Open-source MCP plugin & agent skill saving up to 98% of context window by sandboxing tool outputs and maintaining persistent local SQLite search history.

npxSkills.notes: Installs the context-mode instructions and ops skill.

npxSkillInstall.notes: Shorthand installer command when supported by package manager.

customCommands.name: Claude Code Plugin Marketplace (Recommended)
customCommands.description: Installs full plugin with auto-routing hooks and MCP tools within Claude Code.

customCommands.name: Claude MCP Direct Addition (Tool-Only)
customCommands.command: claude mcp add context-mode -- npx -y context-mode
customCommands.description: Connects Context-Mode as an MCP server without conversational routing hooks.

context-mode.troubleshooting: If tool output sandboxing fails, run /context-mode:ctx-doctor to check node and SQLite dependencies.
